designSource.componentIndexSummary: 6 components (mobile-top-tab, mobile-right-rail, mobile-bottom-info, mobile-bottom-nav, web-video-card, editorial-mag-cover). Only top-tab (text-only tabs + 1px primary underline, hover=secondary) and editorial-cover (mono metadata, sparing red/cyan accent spans) are usable for this enterprise web app; mobile feed components are out of scope for desktop SaaS chrome.
designSource.uiKitSummary: ui_kits/app/index.html is a mobile short-video shell (phone frame, top tab, right rail, bottom info, bottom nav). Not applicable to desktop SaaS sidebar/topbar layout; token + type discipline is carried over instead.
designSource.designDecisionSummary: Dark editorial 'control-room' language derived from TikTok tokens: background #0B0B10, card #161823, card-elevated #1C1E2A, video-bg #16161C for sidebar; foreground #F5F5F7 / muted-foreground #AEB2C0; primary red #FE2C55 (CTAs, high-risk HITL, active underline, red-dot badges), secondary cyan #25F4EE as small accent (agent identity, route highlights); border #3A3D52 hairline separators; radius 2/6/8/12 restrained; Inter + JetBrains Mono kicker (11px, 0.14em uppercase); spacing rhythm 4/8/12/16/24/32; border-first depth (no decorative shadows); red/cyan <=10% area.

iconAssets.coloringRule: currentColor by default; override with Library token when needed

project.visualNorthStar: 全链路留痕的智能控制室：暗色高对比基底 + 红主青辅的品牌强调，mono kicker 元数据贯穿，边框分层替代阴影，让 Agent 路由、记忆召回、HITL 与执行回放清晰可见、可追溯。
project.compositionPattern: app-shell dashboard with sidebar navigation + task/information-dense content panes; login uses editorial split auth layout
continuityAnchors: shared dark app shell (232px sidebar + 56px topbar, hairline border separation) across all 7 app pages
red primary CTA / red dot badges + cyan agent-identity accents
mono uppercase kicker metadata on every page header and card
radius 2/6/8/12 restrained, border-first surfaces, no decorative shadows
line icon language (Library masks + Lucide fallback)

sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: primary #FE2C55 (red), secondary #25F4EE (cyan) accent-only; neutral surfaces background/card/card-elevated/video-bg
sharedProjectShellContract.typeStack: Inter sans for UI, JetBrains Mono for kicker/metadata; body 13-14px, headings 16-18px weight 600
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceModel: border-first, hairline 1px var(--border) separators, no decorative shadows
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: red primary buttons with white text, ghost/secondary buttons with border + muted text
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRhythm: left-edge aligned sidebar, topbar baseline title row, content max-width fluid

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: dark neutral surfaces (#0B0B10/#161823/#1C1E2A) + red primary #FE2C55 + cyan secondary #25F4EE accents + status success/error tokens
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: radius 2/6/8/12, 1px hairline borders, pill only for badges/avatars
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: Inter sans + JetBrains Mono kicker (11px/0.14em uppercase), body 13-14px, headings 16-18px w600
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: cards = card surface + 1px border; buttons = red primary / bordered ghost; nav active = card-elevated + foreground; tabs = text + 1px primary underline
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border-first; shadow only for floating layers (drawers/modals/dropdowns)
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: line icons 2px stroke; Library SVG masks preferred, Lucide fallback; avatars = initials circles
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: hover = surface step + color step, 0.18s ease transitions; focus-visible rings; reduced-motion respected
